meta.title: Issuing a counter offer with zero or negative price is refused

plan.title: Reject Counter Offer Above Vendor Price

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer’s Responses tab.
Open the buyer’s comparison grid so the vendor’s current bid and counter-offer control are available.
Verify that Vendor A’s current bid is the prepared value of 100.

args.because: lower than the vendor's current price

steps.note: Attempt to submit the higher counter price and require Procol to refuse it with a message indicating the counter must be lower than the vendor’s current price.
